# hetznerrobot_storagebox_snapshot (Resource)

A manual snapshot of a Storage Box, taken when the resource is created and deleted on destroy. Only the comment can change in place. Only the inclusive **BX10 (100 GB)** Storage Box of a dedicated server is still managed through Robot; every other Storage Box moved to the [Hetzner Console API](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/hetzner#storage-boxes) (the `hcloud` provider). Every Storage Box write is limited to one request per 5 seconds, which the provider waits out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hetznerrobot_storagebox_snapshot" "before_upgrade" {
  storagebox_id = hetznerrobot_storagebox.backup.id
  comment       = "before the database upgrade"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `storagebox_id` (Number) Storage Box the snapshot belongs to.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment on the snapshot.

### Read-Only

- `automatic` (Boolean) Whether the snapshot plan created the snapshot (always false for this resource).
- `filesystem_size` (Number) Size of the box's data when the snapshot was taken, in MB.
- `name` (String) Snapshot name, its creation time (`2026-10-11T12-00-00`).
- `size` (Number) Size of the snapshot in MB; grows as the box's data moves away from it.
- `timestamp` (String) Creation time in UTC.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_storagebox_snapshot.before_upgrade 123456/2026-10-11T12-00-00
```
